claims.text: Section 353 of the Karnataka Municipal Corporations Act provides that a place within city limits may not be used for purposes listed in Schedule X without a licence from the Commissioner, subject to statutory provisos including an MSME/large-industry exemption inserted by amendment.
claims.notes: Category and exemption applicability require case-specific legal/current municipal review.

claims.text: The current GBA public home lists Trade License and Trade License Renewal among e-Services, while the BBMP citizen-service index lists new registration, renewal, FAQ and contact links.
claims.notes: Directory labels do not guarantee legacy URL continuity after GBA corporation transition.

claims.text: BBMP's public new-registration guide says to open Trade License/New Registration, enter mandatory fields, continue, upload owner consent letter or lease agreement and electricity bill, send an OTP, choose the number of years and proceed to payment.
claims.notes: Guide is a public workflow document; no field, OTP, upload or payment was used.

claims.text: The BBMP FAQ lists owner consent/lease copy and electricity bill for a new trade, says occupancy certificate is included if available, accepts JPG/PDF with a stated maximum 1 MB file size, and says new/renewal applications can select 1–5 years; it also lists status and certificate/receipt functions.
claims.notes: FAQ is legacy/dated; current category-specific checklist and file validation are unknown.

claims.text: The official OTLS description says a new case captures applicant/trade/premises/ward and trade classification details, creates a temporary application number/payment challan, supports online or offline payment, then describes inspection/document verification through MoH, DHO and HO before final approval by the Joint Commissioner and license download/issue.
claims.notes: IT description is dated 2019 and should not be treated as a current GBA service-level promise.

claims.text: No official public source reviewed establishes a supplied trade's Schedule X/category applicability, current GBA corporation/ward/MOH routing, current fee, exemption, inspection outcome, approval timing or issued licence.
claims.notes: No login, OTP, personal data, upload, payment or application was performed.
